findings.issue: A response submitted after worker exit could wait indefinitely for another callback.
findings.disposition: The native post-tool hook now wakes an idle worker.

findings.issue: An unavailable Codex inbox prevented independent OpenCode registration.
findings.disposition: The worker handles an unavailable source independently.

findings.issue: Installer rollback could delete an inbox created by a competing process.
findings.disposition: Rollback checks ownership of the displaced directory.

findings.issue: Installer replacement could overwrite concurrent TOML edits.
findings.disposition: Installer transactions verify file identity and retain intervening changes during recovery.

findings.issue: An empty sandbox settings table might crash the TOML editor.
findings.disposition: Refuted in independent empty, inline and adjacent-table fixtures.

findings.issue: Repeated bounded workers could starve eligible registrations beyond the first scan window.
findings.disposition: Persist the sweep cursor and remaining count across worker lifetimes.

findings.issue: Source verification could consume a per-owner allowance repeatedly within one sweep.
findings.disposition: Charge session and byte use to the same bounded pass.

findings.issue: Inbox separation omitted selected manager and engine paths.
findings.disposition: Check executable paths alongside registry and publication locations.

findings.issue: Submission acknowledged responses when changed configuration made the inbox unusable.
findings.disposition: Revalidate current private-path separation before writing.

findings.issue: Removing a consumed slot by its pathname could delete a newer entry.

reporters.identity_note: Coordinator observation; executed model and effort unavailable.

findings.disposition: Keep completed slots. Verified registrations make later scans idempotent.

findings.issue: Regression tests did not establish restart progress beyond the first bounded worker lifetime.
findings.disposition: The native fixture observes distinct worker PIDs, build identity, scan progress and binding.

findings.issue: A trusted hook could select a worktree-writable engine.

reporters.identity_note: Coordinator observation; executed model and effort unavailable.

findings.disposition: The operator approved protected manager and engine selection in iteration 03.

findings.issue: A delayed source flush could leave a valid queued response without another proof attempt.
findings.disposition: An authenticated pending response gets bounded retry time, then remains recoverable.

findings.issue: Malformed worker progress could block processing of otherwise durable registrations.
findings.disposition: Restart the bounded scan from durable registrations and record recovery.
